rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a benefit or positive consequence, especially when asking what benefit something gives.

example.english: What is the advantage of doing this?
example.jyutping: gam3 zou6 jau5 me1 hou2 cyu3

rows.note: Choose this for a superior position or competitive edge, including a favorable position, a general advantage, or the one-point advantage after deuce in tennis.

example.english: This team has a clear advantage in speed.
example.traditional: 呢隊喺速度方面有明顯優勢。
example.jyutping: ni1 deoi6 hai2 cuk1 dou6 fong1 min6 jau5 ming4 hin2 jau1 sai3

rows.note: Use this colloquial word for a practical or personal advantage, such as getting a better deal or having circumstances in your favor.

example.english: Buying two items now gives you an advantage.
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 maai5 loeng5 gin6 jau5 zoek6 sou3
